cd /workspace && timeout 180 python3 - <<'PY'
import sys,time,random,json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from netnomos.finite import compile_job
rng=random.Random(7);D=list(range(256))
fields=[{'name':'x','type':'count','domain':D},{'name':'y','type':'count','domain':D}]
preds=[]
for a in range(16): preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'x']},'op':'ne','right':{'const':a,'type':'count'}})
for b in range(16): preds.append({'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'y']},'op':'ne','right':{'const':b,'type':'count'}})
train=[[[a,255]] for a in range(16)]+[[[255,b]] for b in range(16)]
queries=[]
for i in range(64):
 t=rng.choice(['x','y']); fixed=[]
 if rng.random()<.7: fixed=[{'ref':[0,'y' if t=='x' else 'x'],'value':rng.randrange(256)}]
 pref=''.join(str(rng.randrange(10)) for _ in range(rng.randrange(8)))
 queries.append({'fixed':fixed,'target':[0,t],'prefix':pref})
job={'fields':fields,'slots':1,'predicates':preds,'width':4,'train':train,'approved':[],'queries':queries}
st=time.time();r=compile_job(job);print('first',time.time()-st,len(r['rules']))
job['approved']=[x['clause'] for x in r['rules']]
st=time.time();r2=compile_job(job);print('active',time.time()-st,len(r2['rules']),len(r2['active']),r2['answers'][:3])
PY
